title: Top-N per Group & Deduplication in SQL

scenes.line1: How do you get the top earners
scenes.say: How would you find the highest paid people in every department using SQL?

scenes.label: ROW_NUMBER
scenes.sub: Assigns a unique rank to each row within a group.
scenes.say: The row number function gives each row a unique rank inside its group.
Here's how you grab the top three earners in every department using row number and partition by.

rows.b: Group by your key, like user or email
Sort by your business rule, like latest date
Assign row numbers within each group
Pick only the first row per group

scenes.say: To deduplicate, group your data, sort it, assign row numbers, then keep only the first row for each group.

scenes.question: What does PARTITION BY do?
scenes.wrong: It sorts the rows in the table.
scenes.right: It splits rows into groups so window functions work within each group.
scenes.say: Don't mix up partition by with order by. Partition by splits your data into groups for the window function.
